matched.title: SEP-10 client signs a transaction returned by a remote signer without checking its operations

findings.title: swap and path payments default to no slippage bound (destMin 0.0000001, sendMax int64 max)
SEP-7 URI signature is never verified or reported, so tampered tx and replace parameters pass as valid requests
SEP-24 extraFields spread after the asset allowlist check can override asset_code and account
Sponsored createAccount takes an uncapped sponsor-funded startingBalance
Payment, path-payment and create-account builders have no code-enforced maximum amount
SEP-7 tx URI returns a transaction with no timebounds check, so a signed envelope can stay valid indefinitely
SEP-7 tx URI chooses the signing network passphrase, defaulting to PUBLIC
SEP-7 validator checks tx XDR against an attacker-chosen network passphrase defaulting to PUBLIC
Account authority changes built from counterparty-supplied signer keys
maxFee cap is dropped on the first fee-increase retry, so later retries are uncapped
Recovery signer key taken from server response without verification, then installed by a master-key-locking transaction
SigningKeypair.sign signs any transaction it is given, with no operation check (reachable via Server/index.ts:64)
Domain signer result is decoded and returned without checking it against the transaction that was sent
SEP-10 client signs a transaction returned by a remote signer without checking its operations
Server-side challenge signer verifies only the anchor signature, then signs with the account key without checking operations or timebounds
SEP-6 bearer JWT is sent to a transferServer taken from stellar.toml with no https check
SEP-12 client sends the SEP-10 bearer token to a kycServer URL from stellar.toml with no https check
Withdrawal payment is built from anchor-supplied destination, amount and memo with no check against the user's request
Fee bump and transaction base fee are not capped; fee is taken from input
SEP-10 memo interpolated unencoded into challenge URL; integer check bypassed
getInfo accepts a caller-chosen Horizon server and returns its data unchecked
SEP-7 pubkey param is parsed but never enforced against the signing key
SEP-38 bearer JWT sent to quote server from stellar.toml with no scheme or host check
Network-failure error path serializes the whole axios request, which can include the bearer token
Timed-out payment is resubmitted without reconciling by hash, and an applied payment can be reported as failed
fundTestnetAccount calls friendbot regardless of the configured network
getHistory limit check only enforces the upper bound
build() re-adds every queued operation on each call, so a second build duplicates payments
parseAnchorTransaction throws a raw TypeError on JSON null
Fee-increase retry multiplies the fee by the operation count instead of adding the increment
Sep6.info cache ignores the lang parameter, so a later call returns info in the wrong language
Remote signer's token returned unchecked; a missing token silently drops the Authorization header
addAssetSupport with no limit creates an unlimited trustline
SEP-7 replace parser silently truncates hints and txrep entries that contain extra colons
Recovery thresholds and signer weights are not checked against the installed signer set, so a misconfiguration can lock the account
getServicesInfo builds an info URL from transferServerSep24 without checking it exists or is set
Sep7Pay factory, constructor and setters store unvalidated destination, amount, asset and memo values
Customer update lets SEP-9 fields override the explicit id, type, memo and transaction_id
Sep7Pay amount setter and getter accept any string, with no decimal, sign or precision check
Sep7Pay asset_issuer setter is independent of asset_code, so a code can be set without a valid issuer
Sep7Pay memoType setter accepts any string, and hash-memo values are not checked for encoding or length
Customer add() lets a sep9Info type key override the explicit type argument
Remote signer response body is decoded without a presence or type check; fee-bump envelopes are cast to Transaction
NotAllSignaturesFetchedError is swallowed and rewrapped as ServerRequestFailedError
camelToSnakeCaseObject silently overwrites a field when two keys differ only by case convention
parseToml throws a raw TypeError when stellar.toml has no DOCUMENTATION table, breaking SEP-1, SEP-10 and SEP-6 setup for that anchor
submitTransaction dereferences e.response without a guard, hiding the real failure and leaving callers unsure whether the transaction was applied
lockAccountMasterKey sets master weight 0 with no check that remaining signers can authorize
setThreshold accepts thresholds above the total signer weight with no range or sum check
SEP-7 tx XDR has no length limit before decoding
Recovery server response parsed outside the error wrapper; malformed body throws raw TypeError
Recovery server co-signature is attached without verification
Sponsorship begin op left unpaired when the building callback throws
getUrlDomain throws a raw TypeError on invalid or empty input
SEP-10 JWT accepted without signature verification or account binding
Caller-supplied IDs interpolated unencoded into bearer-authenticated anchor URLs
getQuote interpolates quoteId unencoded into a bearer-authenticated URL
Caller-supplied IDs interpolated unencoded into bearer-authenticated anchor URLs
Caller-supplied exp is signed without an upper bound
defaultTimeout accepts 0, so built transactions have no expiry
StellarConfiguration accepts a network passphrase and Horizon URL from different networks without a check
SEP-24 asset allowlist matches asset code only, not code plus issuer
